Treatment names and types
Registry 1.0.0

Curated treatment registry and source-bound R2/R3 normalization review. Report counts overlap; they are not counts of independent studies. This is not a list of approved melanoma therapies.
Verified complete aliases and broad classes use one registry. Unknown identities, formulations and source-dependent roles remain in the review queue. Original evidence and numerical results are unchanged.
